notes:
New: install app bundles.
- Tap an XAPK, APKS or APKM file (or use the menu on a folder of split APKs): BFE shows the app, its version and the parts this device needs, already ticked. Install sends them to Android in one go, with progress and Cancel.
- XAPK game data goes into Android/obb, and only once Android reports the app installed. A cancelled install leaves nothing behind.
- Convert to one APK: joins a bundle into a single APK signed with your key.
- The app name and icon are read from the app itself when the bundle has none.

Tried on a Pocket FIT: reading XAPK, APKM and APKS files, an install up to Android's confirm screen, and cancelling it. Not tried yet: a finished install, Convert, and folders of split APKs.
